verified_unit_behaviors: Shared FIFO selection and exact locked claims, commit before processor, idle wait and uncertain claim commit
Cancellation control distinct from lease loss, throttled monotonic progress and final flush before validation
No state mutation by a stale attempt, finite retry on interruption, sanitized deterministic failures
Cancellation finalization only after processor and child supervision unwind
Immutable v1 snapshot and complete trim passed to the compositor; v2 audio uses its separate inventory
SHA-256, private modes, absent source, symlink, FIFO/nonregular output, artifact mismatch and full output budget
No overwrite/adoption of canonical artifacts, workspace cleanup and preservation after lease loss or uncertain commit
limitations: Injected renderer artifacts are unit-only byte fixtures, not evidence of encoded media validity.
SQLite unit tests do not establish PostgreSQL locks, process signals or real FFmpeg output; those checks are coordinated separately.
